name: digitalygo/envai-teams-sdk-php
description: Official PHP SDK for Envai: a framework-independent typed HTTP client and an ATP v2 runtime for chat, streaming, definitions and client tools.

suggest.ext-fileinfo: Required to detect the MIME type of multipart file uploads
suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: Required to use the MySQL or MariaDB database state store
suggest.ext-pdo_pgsql: Required to use the PostgreSQL database state store
suggest.ext-pdo_sqlite: Required to use the SQLite database state store
suggest.illuminate/config: Required to publish and read the package config (^11.0|^12.0|^13.0)
suggest.illuminate/console: Required to register the Envai artisan commands (^11.0|^12.0|^13.0)
suggest.illuminate/contracts: Required for the Laravel service provider and its contracts (^11.0|^12.0|^13.0)
suggest.illuminate/database: Required to use the Laravel database sync state store (^11.0|^12.0|^13.0)
suggest.illuminate/support: Required for the ServiceProvider and support classes used by the Laravel integration (^11.0|^12.0|^13.0)
